caveats: Shadow mode records ingest and recommendations. It does not execute controls.
HTTP 200 from this API is not attack success and is not a healthy verdict.
This report does not claim that shadow mode prevented breaches.
Q-values are stored scores, not a probability that an attack is happening now.
Analyst accept is a recorded opinion and does not execute.

health.policy_status_reason: No live policy-health producer. Shadow decisions stay NOT_EXECUTED; HTTP 200 is not policy health.
health.status_reason: No recorded health-check producer. Timestamps are evidence only; HTTP 200 is not a healthy verdict.
health.telemetry_status_reason: Ingest timestamps are not a telemetry health verdict.
health.worker_status_reason: No worker liveness producer. Heartbeat timestamps are evidence only.

unsupported_claims: health is healthy because this endpoint returned 200
infrastructure completeness authorizes a customer pilot
merged research PRs, unit tests, or docs are model readiness
Q-value is a probability of attack
